text: Objective: Through one year study, students could learn business etiquette, be familiar with business practice, improve the ability of using business Chinese and apply or carry out business work with what you have learnt during class. Characteristics: Analog business class & small size & practice teaching Courses: Practical Chinese Listening and Reading, Practical Comprehensive Chinese, Daily Chinese Conversation, Business Chinese Listening, Business Chinese Reading, Business Correspondence, Lecture on Enterprize Culture and Cooperation of Chinese and Foreign Companies etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.
